value.brief:
Please read and summarise this file: /private/var/folders/3b/5kzs662j47v6vdz26gbkvlgc0000gn/T/tea-evaluate-mutated-M-012-17666f60-bd30-4f7a-9155-27283fd37ea8/target/peer-sessions/docs/coordination-contract-v1.md

Scope: only read this file and write the summary. Do not edit, create or delete any files, do not run spawn or teardown scripts, and do not message other sessions.

In the summary, cover:
- what the contract is for and who produces or consumes it
- the receipt/JSON format: its top-level fields and the fields for each session
- status values and exit codes, and what each one means
- how correlation IDs (--correlate) are carried through
- any versioning or compatibility rules

Keep it under about 300 words. When you're done, reply to me with your summary. Use this format:
orbits done: <summary>
If you can't read the file, reply instead with:
orbits blocked: <reason>
